about: What one read of the daily plan costs (agenda.replay, as retrieval.daily reads it) in plans made afresh on the same records (agenda.afresh), CPU time, best of five, recorded on 16 Nov 2026 under load. pre: f2e4dd07, the engine before 64a55b02 (L1's replay that reads each day's final review); after: 64a55b02 and cf5a43e6, the round-12 base; reached: fix round 12's M1 (memo.py: a read keeps each history it reads once). The check fails once a read costs more than halfway from reached back to after.
